title: Ann Taylor — Family & Biography
body_markdown:
# Ann Taylor (~1856–?)

**Role:** Wife of John Telfer (1847–1923)

Ann Taylor married John Telfer at St John's Church, Kapunda in 1881. Together they had nine children: Ann, Johnnie, Peter, Adam, Robina, Margaret, William, James, and Jessie.

**Source:** *From the Borders to the Bush* — Chapter on John Telfer
